frequency_and_phase_scope.current_frequency_features: No separate current frequency index is injected into the scorer. The shared frequency head also uses the retained pre-final context.
frequency_and_phase_scope.current_observation_to_shared_gate: Only the current 4x4 response rows enter the shared gate scorer directly; the final post-response recurrent state is not used by the shared action heads.
frequency_and_phase_scope.goal_conditioning: bilinear interaction between each current response row and retained pre-final central-plus-memory context
frequency_and_phase_scope.phase_or_time_claim: Magnitude-only response measurements are not converted into an invented phase or time signal.
frequency_and_phase_scope.retained_frequency_information: The retained context can carry frequency/goal information encoded during the note and delay; no evaluator gate or frequency label is supplied to inference.
frequency_and_phase_scope.trajectory_scope: final response hook only; this does not claim full-trajectory slot causality
